slides.heading: pop()
slides.body: pop() is part of List Operations and Methods. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: pop()
slides.body: pop() removes and returns an item from a list. Without an index, it removes the last item.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: pop() is like taking the top card from a stack and keeping it in your hand.
